summary: Implemented the feature by reading and editing files only; no tests, scripts, or installs were run, and nothing was committed. New data modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize; insertion-ordered cache; overwrite-false merge per the spec) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with save, save_batch, private static _create_file_basename; writes via write_nifti; dtype defaults to the data's own dtype). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, leaving the existing GIF helpers unchanged. Rewrote monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, and tensorboard_handlers.py as thin adapters: the classification handler registers an engine-accepting bound method for the COMPLETED hook; the TensorBoard handler gained an index parameter before max_channels and delegates to the plot function. Changed the write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py, and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename, and added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. A grep check found no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, and every edited file ends with a single newline. Not verified: flake8, the test suite, and the ignite 0.3.0 attach path. Choices to review: the CSV merge skips blank lines; the TensorBoard handler calls batch_transform once instead of twice; the classification handler keeps a logger attribute it never uses.
